description: Top-level index cross-referencing every extracted hyperMILL CAM module — tool database, stock + fixture, simulation, automation center, post processor, drilling/hole-making, 5-axis, mill-turn, MAXX (barrel-cutter). Consumed by HyperMillFunctionIndexEngine for parameter discovery, dependency tracing, and AI orchestration.

modules.description: Tool holder, cutter geometry, cutting data, wear limits, coating, and metadata fields surfaced in the hyperMILL tool database UI. Inputs to Kienzle force model and Taylor tool life.
Stock model definition and workholding/fixture catalog parameters including clamping force, jaw geometry, and pull-out resistance. Feeds prism_safety workholding gate.
Material removal simulation, collision check, and machine kinematic verification settings. Consumes tool_database geometry and stock_fixture clamps.
hyperMILL Automation Center (AC) macro library, template inheritance, and feature recognition rules. Drives autonomous toolpath generation.
PPG (Post Processor Generator) configuration: controller dialect, kinematic chain, NC code emit options, RTCP/G68.2 enable flags.

Drilling, hole-making, and probing cycles — 15 drilling cycles (spot/peck/deep-hole/gun/boring/reaming/tapping/thread-mill/countersink/counterbore/back-spot-face/chamfer/helical-bore/circular-pocket-drill/combined-cycle, 402 params) + 8 probing cycles (setup/bore/boss/web/surface probes, tool setter, tool breakage, datum probe, 74 params). Sourced from HyperMillDrillingProbingAutomationAPI.json.

Full simultaneous 5-axis and 3+2 indexed strategies — swarf cutting, tool axis at point, normal-to-surface, contour milling, equidistant 5-axis, parallel-projection 5-axis, blade/blisk roughing+finishing, port/cavity 5-axis, deburring, plus impeller-specific cycles. 15 ops, 512 params. Schema v2 nested-module shape.

Mill-Turn integrated turning + live-tooling cycles — turning roughing/finishing/grooving/threading/parting + driven-tool C-axis milling, polygon turning, sub-spindle synchronization. 10 ops, 179 params. Schema v2 nested-module shape. NOTE: file is named turning-operations.json but the module_id within is 'millturn' — the catalog covers full mill-turn capability, not turning-only.

MAXX Machining — hyperMILL signature high-feed module using barrel/circle-segment cutters for large-radius blending and engagement-controlled finishing. 3 ops (MAXX Finishing, MAXX Roughing, MAXX Pre-Finishing), 156 params. Unique to hyperMILL — no Fusion 360 parallel. Schema v2 nested-module shape.

Inspection planning + analysis + reporting layer above drilling.probing_cycles[]: CMM plan generate, sampling strategy, tolerance stack RSS+Monte Carlo, GD&T validate + zone check, probe compensation calibrate, surface form analyze, generate inspection report, compare-to-CAD. 10 ops, 78 params. Bound to HyperMillFAIBridge. Mirrors Fusion MS1-04 cadence; param-depth expansion to ~150 deferred to MS3-03b/MS3-04.
